metas.name: Sid the Science Kid
metas.description: Explores science concepts in a fun and engaging way, similar to Ada Twist, Scientist and The Magic School Bus.

metas.name: Daniel Tiger's Neighborhood
metas.description: Focuses on social-emotional learning and everyday life situations, with catchy songs, appealing to the same age group as Doc McStuffins.

metas.name: Super Why!
metas.description: Encourages literacy skills and problem-solving through engaging stories, aligning with the educational focus of Peg + Cat and WordGirl.

metas.name: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
metas.description: Introduces science topics through adventurous stories with familiar characters, similar to the spirit of The Magic School Bus.

metas.name: Chuggington
metas.description: Features colorful trains and adventures that teach lessons about teamwork and problem-solving, similar to Special Agent Oso's missions.

metas.name: Wild Kratts
metas.description: Combines adventure with animal facts, encouraging curiosity about the natural world, echoing the educational spirit of Ada Twist, Scientist.

metas.name: Ask the StoryBots
metas.description: Answers curious questions kids have about the world in a fun, musical, and animated way, similar to The Magic School Bus.

metas.name: Sarah & Duck
metas.description: A gentle and whimsical show about a girl and her adopted duck, focusing on simple concepts and imagination, fitting the charm of Bluey.

metas.name: Octonauts
metas.description: Explores underwater environments and marine life with a team of animal adventurers, offering educational fun like Wild Kratts.

metas.name: Paw Patrol
metas.description: A team of rescue pups who solve problems, with a focus on teamwork and helping others, appealing to the same audience as Doc McStuffins.

metas.name: Bubble Guppies
metas.description: An energetic and educational show set in an underwater world, teaching about various topics through songs and games, similar to Peg + Cat.

metas.name: Tinga Tinga Tales
metas.description: Explains how different animals got their characteristics through vibrant African folklore and animation, a creative educational series.

metas.name: Peter Rabbit
metas.description: Adventures of the famous rabbit, focusing on nature and problem-solving, reminiscent of Curious George's gentle explorations.

metas.name: Go, Diego, Go!
metas.description: An interactive show that teaches about animals and the environment, with an emphasis on problem-solving, similar to Special Agent Oso.

metas.name: Pocoyo
metas.description: A minimalist and visually appealing show that teaches basic concepts and social skills to young children.

metas.name: Tumble Leaf
metas.description: A beautifully animated stop-motion series that encourages exploration and experimentation through gentle storytelling.

metas.name: Molly of Denali
metas.description: Features an Alaska Native protagonist who shares her culture and teaches about science and nature, an engaging educational series.

metas.name: Alma's Way
metas.description: Follows a young Puerto Rican girl who learns about her community and problem-solving through music and her family's guidance.

metas.name: Xavier Riddle and the Secret Museum
metas.description: Teaches children about historical figures and events in a fun, time-traveling adventure format.

metas.name: If You Give a Mouse a Cookie
metas.description: Follows the charming logic of Laura Numeroff's popular books, focusing on cause and effect and friendship.

metas.name: Dino Dana
metas.description: A live-action series where a young girl encounters and studies dinosaurs, blending science with imaginative play.

metas.name: Puffin Rock
metas.description: A gentle and beautifully animated show about two young puffins exploring their island home, with a focus on nature and family.

metas.name: Pip and Posy
metas.description: A sweet and gentle series about the friendship between a mouse and a rabbit, exploring everyday childhood emotions and activities.

metas.name: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
metas.description: Features young versions of Marvel superheroes working together to solve problems, with action suitable for young children, akin to WordGirl's heroic nature.

metas.name: Moon and Me
metas.description: A magical and whimsical show with live-action and animation that focuses on imagination, friendship, and discovery.

metas.name: The Wombles
metas.description: Follows a family of underground-dwelling creatures who clean up litter and learn about the environment, promoting eco-consciousness.

metas.name: Guess with Jess
metas.description: A charming show where a cat and her friends learn about the world through observation and asking questions, similar to Curious George.

metas.name: Rainbow Ruby
metas.description: A young girl who travels to a magical world to help her toys, encouraging problem-solving and imaginative play.

metas.name: Doki
metas.description: An animated series where a dog and his friends travel the world learning about different cultures and places.

metas.name: The Big Fib
metas.description: A game show where kids identify a fib told by an adult, encouraging critical thinking and observation skills.

metas.name: Olaf Presents
metas.description: A fun and humorous series where Olaf retells Disney stories in his own unique way, offering lighthearted entertainment.

metas.name: Rhyme Time Town
metas.description: A musical adventure series that uses rhymes and songs to teach young children about language and problem-solving.

metas.name: Chirp
metas.description: Follows a curious baby bird who learns about the world through exploration and asking questions, promoting a sense of wonder.
